name: Bedford County, Pennsylvania (United States)
description: Red field with a square British Union Flag in the canton, charged with an emblem of the county's map in yellow on a blue keystone bearing BEDFORD COUNTY, 1771 above and PENNSYLVANIA below, between two green branches, over a scroll reading CROWN OF THE COMMONWEALTH.
history: Bedford County is a county in the Commonwealth of Pennsylvania. The flag was adopted in 2008 (designed by Todd Greenawalt of Snake Spring Valley and released by the Bedford County Historical Society on 21 January 2008, according to Flags of the World).

features.role: canton with the British Union Flag
map of the county on a blue keystone
scroll reading CROWN OF THE COMMONWEALTH and the dates
